name: Proud Tek Editorial Board
shortBio: Collective byline for content reviewed by Proud Tek's RFID & NFC engineering, compliance and industrial-laundry specialists.
bio: The Proud Tek Editorial Board is the institutional byline used when articles are produced and cross-checked by more than one member of our team. Every article carrying this byline has been (a) drafted by a named subject-matter editor, (b) cross-checked against the original standard (ISO/IEC, GS1, EPCglobal, FCC, ETSI, EU DPP, NFC Forum where relevant) and (c) reviewed by at least one credentialed reviewer listed on the /about/review-board/ page. The board is also responsible for running the corrections process described on /about/corrections/.
expertise: EU Digital Product Passport (GS1 Digital Link)
credentials: Proud Tek houses in-factory RFID laboratory — chip programming, industrial-wash, read-range and durability testing
